_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: A VS Code extension for orchestrating multiple LLMs in-editor, with context compression to keep long coding sessions within budget.
A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that rewrites a raw prompt with an LLM and injects the result directly into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini's input box.
A RAG-based chatbot for querying college course notes, built to cut down on hallucinated answers via source grounding.
A personal rebuild of a document-parsing pipeline that turns structured insurance PDFs into validated, machine-readable JSON.
